purpose: Convert a dispatchable nonexecuting ResponseIntent route into a machine-readable requirement profile for the existing destination authority without binding values, executing the route, or granting authorization.

semantics.ready_true: the execution gate is dispatchable and the route has a known typed requirement profile
semantics.ready_false: the gate is closed, the route is missing, or the route/profile correspondence is invalid
semantics.value_binding: none; this contract describes required input classes only

reverify_direct_math.note: canonical_operation is not inferred from AgentResponseIntent and remains caller/runtime-context input

requirement_fields.name: stable requirement key
requirement_fields.required: whether the next authority handoff requires the value
requirement_fields.value_class: machine-readable value category, not a serialized value schema
requirement_fields.source_authority: which caller/runtime boundary is expected to supply the value

identity.requirements_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over dispatch fingerprint + executor contract + payload mode + ordered requirement descriptors
identity.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not authentication, authorization, or cryptographic integrity

serializable_request_binding.rule: ignore, request_information, and propose_revision may bind serializable payload without execution; reverify remains runtime_handle_binding_deferred

invariants: requirements projection reuses response_intent_execution_gate and cannot reopen a closed gate
the projection never binds actual executor values
the projection never invokes a verifier, review session, or revision chain
the projection never mutates ResolutionEvidenceInbox or Resolution state
executor_contract and routed operation remain distinct concepts
ready does not mean execution authorized
requirement source labels do not authenticate caller-supplied values
existing direct authority APIs remain independently callable escape hatches
future_extensions: explicit execution adapters that consume validated dispatch requests
execution receipt correlation back to the originating dispatch fingerprint
